question: Who was appointed by Hockey India as the new head coach of the Indian men's hockey team in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Craig Fulton.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Craig Fulton:-**

 
 
• **Fulton is a South African who has over 25 years of coaching experience.**
 
• He has previously coached the Irish men's hockey team, the Belgian men's hockey team, and the Belgian women's hockey team.
 
• He has also worked as an assistant coach for the Dutch men's hockey team.
 
• **Hockey India appointed Craig Fulton as the new head coach of the Indian men's hockey team on March 3, 2023.**
 
• He succeeded Graham Reid, who stepped down after India's disappointing performance at the 2023 Hockey World Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
